title: Sunny and the Gentle Breeze | Bedtime Story
description: Join Sonny the Quokka on a magical evening walk as a warm, friendly breeze dances through the bush just for her. A soft and soothing bedtime story from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales, perfect for little ones drifting off to sleep.
narration:
The evening was soft and warm, and little Sonny the quokka padded out into the bush for her evening walk. The air was still and sweet, smelling of dry grass and faraway flowers. Then, very gently, something moved.

A little breeze came. It tickled the tips of the tall grass, making them nod and sway. Sunny felt it brush across her golden-brown fur, soft as a whisper. She smiled her big, round smile.

The breeze drifted through the gum leaves above her. The leaves shivered and shimmered in the moonlight, silver and bright. They made a quiet, shushing sound, like someone saying shhh to the whole wide world.

Sunny followed the breeze along the path. It brought her something sweet — the scent of wattle blossom, yellow and warm, floating through the cool night air. She breathed it in slowly. In. And out.

The breeze curled around her little round ears. It ruffled the fur on her tummy. It swayed the tall reeds by the creek with a gentle hiss. Sunny stood very still and let it move all around her, soft and kind, like a friend saying goodnight.

Then the breeze grew quieter. Softer. It lay down in the grass beside Sunny, and Sunny lay down too. She curled up beneath the whispering gum tree, her eyes growing heavy, her warm little body rising and falling with each slow, easy breath. The breeze sighed. And Sunny sighed too.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, gentle breeze. Goodnight, little one.
